entities.name: The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: “Listen. Did you kill him alone? With my brother’s help or without?”

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The startling, incredibly supercilious tone of this man who had once been his valet, was extraordinary in itself.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ivan jumped up and seized him by the shoulder. “Tell me everything, you viper! Tell me everything!”

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: “They are all here, all the three thousand roubles; you need not count them. Take them,” Smerdyakov suggested to Ivan, nodding at the notes.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.object: The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian
triples.quote: took up the big yellow book that Ivan had noticed at first lying on the table, and put it over the notes. The book was _The Sayings of the Holy Father Isaac the Syrian_.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: revealing your eagerness for your father’s death, and I tell you the public would have believed it all

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I went to the window and shouted to the master, ‘It’s I.’

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: he was awfully crazy about her—and he leaned right out of the window.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I snatched up that iron paper-weight from his table; do you remember, weighing about three pounds?

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I wrapped all the notes in the rag and stuffed it deep down in the hole.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I swung it and hit him on the top of the skull with the corner of it. He didn’t even cry out.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: I swung it and hit him on the top of the skull with the corner of it. He didn’t even cry out.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: even if I’d been suspected, instead of Dmitri Fyodorovitch, or as his accomplice

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: I want to prove to your face this evening that you are the only real murderer in the whole affair

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: perhaps I, too, was guilty; perhaps I really had a secret desire for my father’s ... death, but I swear I was not as guilty as you think

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: or that you’re so sorry for your brother that you are sacrificing yourself to save him and have invented it all against me

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: That was quite right what you taught me, for you talked a lot to me about that.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Listen, you miserable, contemptible creature! Don’t you understand that if I haven’t killed you, it’s simply because I am keeping you to answer to-morrow at the trial.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Ivan took the three rolls of notes and put them in his pocket without wrapping them in anything.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Smerdyakov lifted the book off the notes and laid it on one side.
